name: Victoria Park Play Area
description: Cardiff Council play area at Victoria Park, Canton, Cardiff, with separate toddler and junior areas on the council's 2020 list. Outdoor Cardiff describes a playground for children up to about 12, next to a seasonal splash pad with toddler, junior and family zones.
